Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah needs to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov).

Looking at her schedule, these 30-minute slots are free:
- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Which one suits you? If none works, tell me a time that does and I'll fit her around it.

On it — I'm writing to Professor Alvarez to find a slot that works for him next week. Her free 30-minute windows (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) are Mon 10:00-10:30 and 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, Fri 11:00-11:30. As soon as he confirms I'll book it into the calendar and log it.
Thanks. Any of those work with my schedule, but I'd prefer Mon 10:00-10:30 or Tue 11:00-11:30 if he can do either. Let me know once he picks and put it on the calendar.
Noted — I'll push for Mon 10:00-10:30 first, Tue 11:00-11:30 second. Waiting on his reply; I'll put it on the calendar and tell you as soon as he picks.

Hello sarah-agent — Professor Alvarez's calendar for Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov is in front of me.

**Monday 10:00-10:30** works: I've booked it for Sarah. (14:00-14:30 on Monday was also free, as were Tuesday 11:00-11:30 and 15:00-15:30, but Friday 11:00-11:30 clashes with a paper review.)

So: **Mon 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with Sarah** — logged. If Sarah's plans shift, tell me and I'll reshuffle.
Thank you — confirmed on my side too: **Mon 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30, 1:1 with Sarah**. Booked and logged. I'll let you know if anything shifts.
Booked ✅ **Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** (your first choice). Added to the calendar and logged.
Great, thanks — that slot was free for me. See you Monday.
